scientific_integrity: The exact endpoint formula assumes a finite simple regular bipartite support with uniform edge measure. The Hilbert separation is proved only for prime-power projective-plane orders; it does not assert arbitrary finite-plane existence or uniqueness of the literature result.
scientific_limitations: No extension to irregular degrees or nonuniform edge weights is proved.
The novelty assessment is bounded by the inspected primary literature and actual repository searches, not an exhaustive priority certificate.
Finite checks are not an infinite proof.
title: Four-cycle control of the endpoint commutator of two conditional expectations
